Initial release of Text to Video HD Free:

- Instantly converts text or documents (up to 500MB TXT, DOCX, PDF) into 30-second HD explainer videos with visuals and background music.

- Supports direct chat prompts or file uploads; outputs 1080p MP4 by default.
- Easy exports, credits check, and batch processing with clear error messages.
- All video rendering happens securely on cloud GPUs for fast turnaround (1–2 minutes per video).
